note: Carroll County, IA publishes zoning districts only inside the CAMAVision property viewer (maps.camavision.com/carrollia), which exposes no public ArcGIS REST or download endpoint (maps.camavision.com ArcGIS REST root returns 404). The only ArcGIS Online zoning items are unofficial 2013-era web maps by an individual (Sarah_CarrollCountyGIS) with embedded feature collections and no service URL. City of Carroll zoning is kept as an ordinance map at the City Clerk's office (code 170.06), with no GIS layer.
